title: S1 Governance and Constitutional Source Inventory

primary_sources.notes: Structured S1 extraction covering A1 Standards vs BEP, A2 Roles/Responsibilities/Authority, and A3 Information Management Principles. Contains historical gap flags that require reconciliation against later source and migrated repository content.

Later S1 SELF source. Adds explicit contractual precedence, permitted use/reliance, authority-as-governance rules, lifecycle principles, and a closed A1-A3 scope. It states that role matrices and reliability/suitability rules are delegated to dedicated downstream modules rather than missing from S1 itself.
Human-readable governance narrative aligned with S1 concepts.
Dedicated role-definition source already substantially represented in the repository role registry and role definition objects.

Defines the L1-L7 stack, dependency chain, layer boundaries, validation/evidence expectations, deviation handling and automation capability classification. Its legacy layer semantics require mapping to the repository architecture rather than one-to-one adoption.
Source for standards development and governance process; supports repository curation and promotion rules but should not be confused with project delivery authority.
Binder/index source useful for traceability and identifying canonical S1 source pages, not an independent authority object.

migration_observations: The later S1 SELF source resolves several gaps listed in the earlier extraction JSON, so gap flags must be evaluated chronologically rather than copied forward.
Role enumeration belongs in registries and role definitions; S1 should declare authority principles and delegation boundaries.
Information reliability, suitability, LOD/LOI and permitted reliance are constitutional concerns in S1 but detailed rules are delegated to S2, S5 and S7.
The source layer model must be mapped to the repository architecture; legacy layer numbering is not automatically canonical in GitHub.

provenance.migration_note: Direct source inventory only; no canonical S1 content promoted by this file.
